activity.title: I am proud to share that this past weekend, my partner Adhvaidh Sunny and I won Cal Hacks 12.0, Best Use of ElevenLabs! This was my first collegiate hackathon, and it also happened to be the biggest one in the world, with over 3,600 students participating. We built an AI that can understand natural voice commands, read what’s on your screen, and handle multi-step actions across different apps automatically, basically a system that executes whatever you say, from playing music to scheduling meetings, all in one flow. (Imagine Jarvis from Iron Man) I want to give a huge thank you to Cal Hacks for hosting such an incredible event and ElevenLabs for choosing me and my partner. It was an amazing experience all around! ...more

tash (YC S26) is building the investment platform for trading cards. Today, investing in trading cards still happens almost entirely one card at a time. Investors have to source, price, authenticate, store, and resell assets individually, with no simple way to build diversified exposure to the players, eras, and franchises shaping the market. tash is changing that by turning professionally constructed portfolios of trading cards into investable index products. Investors will be able to access focused themes across the market, from Rising Stars and GOATs to Vintage Pokémon and TCGs, without having to source or manage the underlying cards themselves. tash is actively pursuing SEC qualification to make these products broadly available. Trading cards are the starting point. The long-term vision is to bring the $330B+ collectibles market into public markets, making culturally significant assets investable alongside stocks, ETFs, and other traditional asset classes. Join the waitlist 👉 tash.cards Congrats on the launch, John Ohannesian , Nathan Borshell , Nicolas Sharma , and Victor Shammas ! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gdfiMuhq

Context.dev (YC S26) turns the live web into structured data for AI agents and applications via API. Agents can send URLs, domains, websites, sitemaps, companies, or files and get back clean Markdown, screenshots, company data, or structured JSON matching their schema. Instead of maintaining browsers, proxies, crawlers, parsers, queues, retries, and caches, developers can use one API to collect, structure, and continuously refresh internet data. Context.dev also supports large-scale workloads through Batches and ongoing updates through Monitors. The company is already used by more than 400 customers, including Mintlify, Passionfroot, Rho, Super, and SimilarWeb. Try it with 500 free credits at context.dev . Congrats on the launch, Yahia Bakour ! 🚀 https://lnkd.in/gS9A__f4
